annotations.title: Get a payment link for e-mail

description: Use this when the person wants e-mail addresses with their own domain (e.g. info@their-domain.es) for their palimpalem website. Requires palimpalem sign-in. Without a package it lists the packages with mailboxes, storage and price; with a package it returns a payment link on palimpalem.com. Mailboxes are created after payment. This tool charges nothing.

domain.description: Optional when the website has one domain. The domain for the addresses.

package.description: The e-mail package. Leave empty to see the packages first.

web.description: Optional when the account has one website.
